description: Use when you need a geographic snapshot of where prediction-market attention is concentrated. Returns per-country heat for the current moment (`at=now`) or a past hour (`at=<ISO8601>`). A country's heat is the sum, over its markets that moved in the last 24 hours, of each market's news score |Δprob in points| × log10(1 + 24h volume in USD terms, Manifold mana at 0.01), capped at 100 per market. Cross-venue totals cover Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Predict, Opinion, Limitless, Myriad and Gemini. Hyperliquid, Seer, MNX and XO Market are excluded by design. All-source volume omits Manifold. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Check volume_unavailable for missing country figures on venue-filtered maps.

at.description: 'now' (live cache) or an ISO-8601 timestamp for a past hourly frame.

source.description: Restrict to one source (only honored when at=now): polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini, hyperliquid, mnx, seer, xo.

name: map_heat
title: Country heat map
